## Azalea Crates

 

_Not affiliated with Colorful Azaleas_

  

This mod needs both [Apple Crates](https://modrinth.com/mod/apple-crates) & [Colorful Azaleas](https://modrinth.com/mod/colorful-azaleas) to properly work.


 __________________________________________________________________________________

 

 

### General Information:
 
Apple Crates is a mod that adds functional Crates in which you can stock items and set up shop.

 

This addon only adds in new crates, compatible with TFC.

The added crates are :
 
- Azule
- Bright
- Bromelia
- Cerulean
- Dusk
- Earthen
- Fiss
- Lethe
- Pastoral
- Pitch
- Pluvial
- Roze
- Tecal
- Titanium
- Verdant
- Walnut
